styleSummary: Polished pencil-and-ink storybook illustration with bright Mediterranean color, clean linework, expressive faces, and kid-readable mythic danger.

assets.alt: Odysseus leads armed sailors from their ship toward a walled coastal city with smoke rising behind it.
assets.notes: Primary Cicones scene reference; dramatic raid composition with ship, city, fire, and battle tension.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and sailors at the Cicones' city.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the primary Cicones scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus stands on the shore between his ship and the Cicones' walled city during a spear-filled battle.
assets.notes: Alternate Cicones composition with a strong central Odysseus figure.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus between ship and city during the Cicones battle.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate Cicones composition 1.

assets.alt: Odysseus and his men fight on a beach below a smoking walled city.
assets.notes: Alternate wide Cicones composition with a clear ship-to-city route.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of the Cicones beach battle.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate Cicones composition 3.

assets.alt: Odysseus leads sailors from a beached ship while fires burn in the Cicones' city.
assets.notes: Alternate Cicones composition with the strongest fire and smoke backdrop.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus leading sailors during the Cicones raid.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate Cicones composition 4.

assets.alt: Odysseus gestures back toward the ship while his relaxed crew sit among pink lotus flowers.
assets.notes: Primary Lotus-Eaters reference; lush, dreamy temptation with Odysseus trying to keep the journey moving.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and his crew among lotus flowers near the shore.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Lotus-Eaters scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus and his frightened crew watch storm winds burst from Aeolus' bag on the ship.
assets.notes: Primary Aeolus and Bag of Winds reference; shows both Aeolus giving the bag and the crew accidentally releasing the winds.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of winds bursting from Aeolus' bag on Odysseus' ship.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Aeolus and Bag of Winds scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus' ship escapes a cliff-lined harbor while giant Laestrygonians hurl rocks at the trapped fleet.
assets.notes: Primary Laestrygonians reference; shows the fleet trapped in the harbor while Odysseus' ship escapes.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus escaping the Laestrygonian harbor attack.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Laestrygonians scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus speaks with the prophet Tiresias in a rocky underworld cave surrounded by pale spirits.
assets.notes: Primary Underworld reference; spooky, blue-purple, and grief-filled without gore.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus meeting Tiresias and other spirits in the underworld.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Underworld scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus' ship sails between Scylla's many heads on the cliff and Charybdis' huge whirlpool.
assets.notes: Primary Scylla and Charybdis reference; a wide impossible-choice composition with monster and whirlpool.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus' ship between Scylla and Charybdis.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Scylla and Charybdis passage.

assets.alt: Odysseus reaches toward his hungry crew as they harm the sacred cattle under the angry face of Helios.
assets.notes: Primary Cattle of the Sun reference; dark warning scene with Helios' anger and the crew's disobedience.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and the crew with Helios' sacred cattle.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Cattle of the Sun scene.

assets.alt: Calypso sits beside Odysseus on a lush island while he looks longingly out toward the sea.
assets.notes: Primary Calypso/Ogygia reference; beautiful island setting with Odysseus visibly longing for home.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Calypso and Odysseus on Ogygia.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Calypso/Ogygia scene.

assets.alt: Penelope sits at her loom with Telemachus beside her while suitors feast noisily in the palace behind them.
assets.notes: Primary Trouble in Ithaca reference; Penelope's patience and Telemachus' worry set against the suitors' disorder.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Penelope and Telemachus in the palace with the suitors behind them.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Trouble in Ithaca scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus clings to a branch above stormy water and raft wreckage while Poseidon looms in the clouds near the Phaeacian shore.
assets.notes: Primary storm and Scheria reference; Poseidon's storm destroys the raft as Odysseus struggles toward shore.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus surviving Poseidon's storm and raft wreck.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the storm and Phaeacian shore scene.

assets.alt: Nausicaa offers help to exhausted Odysseus on the Phaeacian shore with the bright palace of Scheria behind them.
assets.notes: Primary Nausicaa and Phaeacian hospitality reference; the rescue beat after the storm, with Scheria established in the background.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Nausicaa helping Odysseus on the shore of Scheria.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the Nausicaa and Phaeacian hospitality scene.

assets.alt: Athena transforms Odysseus into a ragged beggar while careless suitors laugh in the background.
assets.notes: Primary home-in-disguise reference; Athena's transformation makes Odysseus vulnerable and hidden before he enters Ithaca.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Athena disguising Odysseus as a beggar in Ithaca.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Athena transforming Odysseus.

assets.alt: Athena with spear and owl standing beside seated Odysseus near the sea.
assets.notes: Strong Athena design reference; useful for divine guidance scenes.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Athena and Odysseus near the sea.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Athena and Odysseus.

assets.alt: Hermes gives Odysseus help while Circe stands with magical swirls and transformed pigs nearby.
assets.notes: Main Circe, Hermes, and magic style reference.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Hermes, Odysseus, Circe, and transformed pigs.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Circe scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus and his crew face the huge one-eyed Cyclops Polyphemus in a rocky cave.
assets.notes: Main Cyclops danger reference; scary but gore-free.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and crew facing Polyphemus.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Cyclops scene.

assets.alt: Odysseus tied to the mast while his crew rows past singing Sirens on the rocks.
assets.notes: Main Sirens scene reference; danger through music and enchantment.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and crew passing the Sirens.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Sirens scene.

assets.alt: Disguised Odysseus enters the palace yard as Telemachus and Argos notice him while the suitors feast behind them.
assets.notes: Primary beggar-in-palace reference; includes Argos, Telemachus, suitors, and Odysseus' disguise.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of disguised Odysseus entering the palace yard with Argos and Telemachus nearby.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the beggar entering the palace scene.

assets.alt: Disguised Odysseus walks past lounging suitors who mock him outside the palace.
assets.notes: Alternate beggar-in-palace composition focused on the suitors' scorn.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of disguised Odysseus being mocked by the suitors.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate beggar composition 2.

assets.alt: Disguised Odysseus keeps to the edge of the palace while suitors feast and laugh nearby.
assets.notes: Alternate beggar-in-palace composition with Odysseus watching from the margin.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of disguised Odysseus observing the suitors from the edge of the palace.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate beggar composition 3.

assets.alt: Odysseus stands with his bow while Telemachus, Penelope, and the shocked suitors watch in the palace hall.
assets.notes: Primary bow contest reference; captures the moment the room realizes the disguised stranger has Odysseus' strength.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus holding the bow before Telemachus, Penelope, and the suitors.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the primary bow contest scene.

assets.alt: Penelope presents Odysseus' bow beside Telemachus while the suitors gather for the contest.
assets.notes: Alternate bow contest setup reference focused on Penelope announcing the challenge.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Penelope presenting the bow for the contest.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for the bow contest setup image.

assets.alt: Odysseus and Penelope face one another beside the olive-tree bed that proves his identity.
assets.notes: Primary Penelope's test reference; the living olive tree and bed make the secret of their marriage visible.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus and Penelope beside the olive-tree bed.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for Penelope's test and the olive-tree bed.
